name: Sovereign Tower
source:
Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113940/Sovereign_Tower/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在這款劇情豐富的圓桌騎士團經營角色扮演遊戲中，你將成為一座魔法高塔的君主。招募性格古怪的騎士，分派任務，在一個個自視甚高的傢伙之間斡旋，親手開創王國的命運。若是命運不如你所願，那就一次次倒轉時間，發掘秘密，重新書寫未來。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113940/Sovereign_Tower/]Steam[/url]］
